id.description: ID: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. magic-wand.

gameIds.description: The game's internal IDs (wiki infobox, field id), e.g. MAGIC_MISSILE. The app uses them to match data from the mod.

name.description: English name as in the game.

source.description: Pack the entry comes from: base or the ID of a DLC (= folder name).

verified.description: false until the entry has been reliably checked against the wiki.

emoji.description: Placeholder emoji, shown when there is no custom icon or image.

icon.description: File name of a custom icon in public/custom-icons/.

image.description: URL of the original image on the wiki; loaded at runtime.

nameDe.description: Official German name from the game, if it differs from the English one.

nameDeHint.description: Own German translation when there is no official German name; shown in parentheses.

level.description: max = max level needed, any = owning it is enough.
